Objective: Validate piping layout and define pipe supports for stress calculation models of molten salts and HTF system
Scope includes multiple calculation models and associated pipelines
Contains sections on allowable stresses, load combinations, inputs, results, and conclusions
Stress calculations for TES HEX Change using ASME B31.3 Process Piping.
Design conditions include pressure, temperature, and wind loads.
Load combinations cover operating, design, and seismic scenarios.
Inputs include screen captures and input echoes from annexes.
The report contains stress calculation results for different models.
Maximum stress ratings are shown for various load cases.
Nozzle loads are analyzed, with forces and moments provided.
Heaters are referenced with a specific document.
Restraint and stress reports are attached as annexes.
Report on stress calculations for TES HEX change.
Includes data from multiple pages and nozzles.
Points labeled as OPE (Operational) and SUS (Support).
Limits and coordinates provided for each point.
Reference documents mentioned: 4521-ESP-AEPC-075-062-0002, 4521-PLN-LOI-039-062-0001-GAR.
Stress calculations for TES HEX Change
Data includes OPE and SUS points with coordinates, stress, force, moment, torque, and factor
Annexes include Power Block, TES HEX Change_Molten salts MODE1, and TES HEX Change_HTF
Conclusions state stresses are within ANSI/ASME B31.3 - 2014 limits
